passages.text: The account owner for Qinglan Hospital (Qinglan) is sales representative Jiarong Lin; the account owner for Songjian Hospital (Songjian) is sales manager Wenyan Hsu.
Qinglan Hospital uses the Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor and the IP-300 Infusion Pump; Songjian Hospital uses the US-800 Ultrasound System and the Tessiva Ultrasound Probe.
Repairs and calibration at hospitals are scheduled by Technical Service, led by Jiahao Cheng.
